rationale: The foundation package is deterministic and source-safe. The fixture preserves official links and policy evidence without raw PDFs or bulk search payloads; the MP identity and role history are time-bounded to Lok Sabha 18; and the aggregate/profile share the capture lineage. The Lok Sabha-wide question aggregate and absent modern question rows remain explicit missing-data states, so the next slice can safely add operator persistence without treating them as Session 5 facts.

worker_package.objective: Implement the persisted internal parliamentary lifecycle on the existing run/artifact/publication tables: fetch the bounded fixture, inspect source and candidate artifacts, publish a partial internal snapshot, replay the captured fixture deterministically, and rollback publication history. Add a dedicated parliamentary scope so existing judiciary services and payload parsers are unchanged, and expose the lifecycle through the existing CLI operator with --parliament.
stop_if: The service would have to parse a parliamentary payload through a judiciary PublishedSnapshotSchema or alter existing judiciary behavior.
The operator would publish a raw PDF, bulk search result, ranking, score, or unsupported performance judgment.
A partial internal snapshot is silently treated as complete or a Lok Sabha-wide question count is labeled as Session 5.
Need files outside allowed_files or a new database table/migration rather than the existing scoped run/artifact/publication seams.
Verification fails twice for an unrelated repository issue.
deferred: Modern Digital Sansad question-row endpoint and pagination confirmation remain a later source gate; keep question breakdown missing in this fixture.
Internal HTML/JSON read surfaces, methodology page, parity tests, and local demo evidence follow in the next package.
Public beta remains blocked pending source reuse/legal approval, stronger question/session coverage, and publication review.
